 def trim(string: str, length: int = 70) -> str:
     """Trim a string to the given length."""
     return (string[: length - 1] + '...') if len(string) > length else string
+
+
+def tabulate(
+    output: ty.List[ty.Tuple[str, ty.Any]],
+    headers: ty.List[str],
+    tablefmt: str = 'psql',
+) -> str:
+    table = prettytable.PrettyTable()
+    table.field_names = headers
+    table.align = 'l'
+    table.add_rows(output)
+
+    if tablefmt == 'psql':
+        table.border = True
+        table.hrules = prettytable.HEADER
+        table.vrules = prettytable.ALL
+    elif tablefmt == 'simple':
+        table.border = False
+        table.hrules = prettytable.HEADER
+        table.vrules = prettytable.NONE

+        raise ValueError('Unsupported table format: %s' % tablefmt)
